title: Yesterday's Machine Stoppages & Maintenance: Past Simple
description: Report sterile filling line breakdowns, replacement of peristaltic pumps, and autoclave cycle resets using Past Simple.
learning_objectives: Use Past Simple regular and irregular verbs (stopped, replaced, noticed, broke)
Ask and answer simple past questions in maintenance deviation logs
Avoid using present tense with past time adverbials

questions.prompt: Yesterday, the sterile capping machine _____ at 11:20 due to a jammed aluminum cap.

explanations.correct: Regular past tense is 'stopped' with doubled 'p'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'Včera se zařízení zastavilo'. Past Simple: 'stopped'.

questions.prompt: The maintenance engineer _____ the worn peristaltic pump head in 20 minutes.
questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'Inženýr vyměnil čerpadlo'. Use Past Simple 'replaced'.

questions.prompt: The cleanroom operator _____ a pressure drop on the Grade B differential gauge.
questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'Operátor si všiml poklesu tlaku'. Use Past Simple 'noticed'.

questions.prompt: _____ you calibrate the temperature sensor before starting the steam sterilization cycle?

explanations.correct: Past Simple questions use auxiliary 'Did' + base verb 'calibrate'.
explanations.wrong_A: 'Were' cannot pair with bare base verb.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'Zkalibroval jste senzor...?'. Use 'Did you calibrate...'.

questions.prompt: The autoclave heating element _____ during the sterilization phase yesterday afternoon.
questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'Topné těleso prasklo / porouchalo se'. Irregular verb: 'break $\rightarrow$ broke'.

questions.prompt: The line technician _____ not reset the alarm before consulting the shift supervisor.

explanations.correct: Past Simple negative takes 'did not reset'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'Technik neresetoval alarm'. Use 'did not reset'.

questions.prompt: Why _____ the SCADA server lose communication with PLC rack 4 yesterday?

explanations.correct: Past question takes auxiliary 'did': 'Why did the server lose...'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'Proč server ztratil spojení?'. Question requires auxiliary 'did'.

questions.prompt: We _____ a deviation report in the TrackWise system for the line stoppage.

explanations.correct: Regular past tense doubles the consonant: 'logged'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'Zaznamenali jsme odchylku...'. Use Past Simple 'logged'.

questions.prompt: The sterile vial feeder bowl _____ 200 vials per minute before the jam occurred.
questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'Podavač podával 200 lahviček za minutu'. Irregular verb: 'feed $\rightarrow$ fed'.

questions.prompt: Quality assurance _____ the sterile batch after reviewing the autoclave chart records.
questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'Oddělení kvality propustilo šarži'. Use Past Simple 'released'.
